contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (52799.96) on the p8 Summary Page, which is also the 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report) $ 52799.96' printed on all FOUR Schedule A sheets, and which the four sheets' own page subtotals reproduce
contributions.detail: FOUR Schedule A sheets, each gated separately against its own printed 'Subtotal for this page' before the grand total was tested (the ADDENDUM L2 discipline). PDF p2 = 15 rows summing 3,250.00 = its printed $3250. PDF p3 = 15 rows summing 3,037.00 = its printed $3037. PDF p4 = 15 rows summing 42,942.96 = its printed $42942.96. PDF p5 = 4 rows summing 3,570.00 = its printed $3570. 3250 + 3037 + 42942.96 + 3570 = 52,799.96 = the sum-of-all-pages total printed on every sheet = the promoted per-period Box B. Box C (Year to Date) prints the identical 52,799.96 and is NOT summed as an increment; Box A is 0 and Box F (A + B) prints 52,799.96, so period == year-to-date because this is the cycle's first report. 49 rows in all. The one cents-bearing contribution (317.96) is what makes the .96 in every printed total, so the closure is a genuine test and not a round-number coincidence.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (13170.43) on the p8 Summary Page, which is also the 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report) $13170.43' printed on both Schedule B sheets
expenditures.detail: TWO Schedule B sheets, each gated on its own printed page subtotal first. PDF p6 (the sideways-bound sheet) = 15 rows summing 31.20 + 170 + 41.10 + 13.70 + 54.80 + 54.80 + 177.29 + 177.29 + 3207 + 254.57 + 207.97 + 400.21 + 150 + 132.87 + 239.79 = 5,312.59 = its printed $5312.59. PDF p7 = 4 rows summing 85 + 2286.29 + 2486.55 + 3000 = 7,857.84 = its printed $7857.84. 5,312.59 + 7,857.84 = 13,170.43 = the sum-of-all-pages total = the promoted per-period Box D. Box E (YTD) prints the identical 13,170.43 and is never summed as an increment. The ladder closes: Box F - Box D = 52,799.96 - 13,170.43 = 39,629.53, which is exactly what the close box prints. Every printed figure on this filing agrees to the cent — there is no filer-arithmetic delta anywhere.

in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and the two conventions are identical here. Schedule A prints FOUR columns (Date / Name of Contributor / City and Zip Code / Amount) with NO in-kind checkbox column; no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind; the Summary Page carries no in-kind line and no compound '+Inkind' cell. Both conventions give 52,799.96 and 13,170.43 and both close exactly.
